# ghost_issue_label (Resource)

Manages an issue label in a Ghost repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# A single label. color accepts six hex digits, with or without a "#".
resource "ghost_issue_label" "bug" {
  repository  = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  name        = "bug"
  color       = "#D73A4A"
  description = "Something isn't working"

  # Replacing the repository deletes its labels; this recreates the label in
  # the same apply. repo_id doesn't change when the repository is renamed.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id]
  }
}

# A standard set of labels. Label names are case-sensitive.
locals {
  labels = {
    "enhancement" = { color = "a2eeef", description = "New feature or request" }
    "question"    = { color = "d876e3", description = "Further information is requested" }
    "wontfix"     = { color = "ffffff", description = "This will not be worked on" }
  }
}

resource "ghost_issue_label" "standard" {
  for_each = local.labels

  repository  = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  name        = each.key
  color       = each.value.color
  description = each.value.description
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The label name, up to 50 characters. Ghost matches label names case-sensitively, so `bug` and `Bug` are different labels. Renaming updates the label in place.
- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new label. Replacing the repository deletes its labels, so add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id] }` to recreate the label in the same apply.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Six hex digits, with or without a leading `#`. Defaults to `ededed`.
- `description` (String) A short description of the label.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository's full name and the label name, `owner/slug:name`.
- `label_id` (Number) The numeric label ID.
- `node_id` (String) The GraphQL node ID.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `url` (String) The label's API URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Labels are imported by the repository's full name and the label name,
# "owner/slug:name". The label name may itself contain ":" or "/".
terraform import ghost_issue_label.bug my-user/example:bug
```
